name: ubereats-pp-mcp
description: Your Uber Eats order history as a local database — spend, favourites, and search the app cannot answer.

ubereats_base_url.title: UBEREATS_BASE_URL
ubereats_base_url.description: Optional. Sets UBEREATS_BASE_URL for the Uber Eats MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.

ubereats_cookies.title: UBEREATS_COOKIES
ubereats_cookies.description: Uber Eats consumer endpoints are cookie-session only. Sign in at ubereats.com in Chrome, then run auth login --chrome. There is no public buyer OAuth.

ubereats_user_agent.title: UBEREATS_USER_AGENT
ubereats_user_agent.description: Optional. Sets UBEREATS_USER_AGENT for the Uber Eats MCP server. Per-instance, non-secret setting; not a credential.
